reason: Rank constant_shape_512 first: its bounded n=512 dispatch can test fixed-trip-count code generation while preserving the existing general fallback, but expected benefit is modest because it retains the full transpose and may duplicate compiler specialization. Rank cache_conflict_layout second: padding and matching pack, load, stride, and rewind changes could reduce cache-set conflicts, but that cause is unverified and the larger scratch footprint and address changes raise correctness risk. The measured panel32 experiment did not show a repeatable gain; historical noisy scheduling results also support neither proposal as a measured win. Both remain unverified.
